BillHeading.BriefDescription: Recognizing the month of September as the month of the kindergartener.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recognizing the month of September as the month of the kindergartener; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.230 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28A.230 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Each month of September is declared the month of the kindergartener, and each elementary school is encouraged to determine a method to celebrate new kindergarteners as they begin their life in education.
